data.name: n1-deny
data.yaml_source:
# §4.2 — an LLM-driven MCP tool call routed through the Preloop safety layer.
# Config shape is the one the issue specifies. The bearer token is injected from
# the environment at run time and is never written into this file.
workflow:
  name: n1-deny
  entry_point: use_tool
  limits:
    max_iterations: 6
  runtime:
    provider:
      name: claude-agent-sdk
      setting_sources: [user]
    default_model: sonnet
    mcp_servers:
      preloop:
        type: http
        url: "http://console/mcp/v1"
        headers:
          Authorization: "Bearer ${PRELOOP_MCP_TOKEN}"
agents:
  - name: use_tool
    prompt: |
      Call the MCP tool `write_marker` with name exactly "deny-path".
      Then call `list_markers` and report exactly what it returned.
    output:
      markers:
        type: string
        description: What list_markers returned
    routes:
      - to: $end
output:
  markers: "{{ use_tool.output.markers }}"
